{{Quote|So, General Grievous, we meet at last. In the name of the Republic, I&mdash;urrrk!|Sannen|<ref name="NEGD" />}}
'''Sannen''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="NEGD" /> who served as a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Grievous" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Sannen [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] alongside<ref name="Grievous" /> his<ref name="NEGD" /> fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Tyneir Renz]], during a [[Battle of Parein II 4/Legends|battle]]<ref name="Grievous" /> on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="Parein II">{{CSWECite|III|13|Parein II}}</ref> [[Parein II 4/Legends|Parein II 4]]. Their forces were crushed in a charge led by the Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] astride his [[Tsmeu-6 personal wheel bike]].<ref name="Grievous" /> Sannen encountered Grievous for the first time and<ref name="NEGD" /> bravely<ref name="Fact File 13">{{FactFile2014|13|MAG 1-2|Grievous' MagnaGuards}}</ref> attempted to subdue him for the Republic.<ref name="NEGD" /> Before he could duel Grievous,<ref name="Clone Wars">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.14|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.14]]</ref> Sannen was jabbed in the [[Throat/Legends|throat]]<ref name="NEGD" /> with an [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]] by one of Grievous's [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]], which [[Death/Legends|killed]] him.<ref name="Galaxies">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68375&month=072009|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Game Update 12 -- Engineering Trader}}</ref> Sannen's death indicated to many that the MagnaGuards were capable of defeating Jedi.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|108|Versus|Versus: Imperial Royal Guard vs. MagnaGuard}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
General Sannen was first mentioned in "[[The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War]]," an article written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and published online on [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club]] on [[February 15]], [[2006]].<ref name="Grievous" /> The character was originally created for the reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'',<ref name="Endnotes">{{Blog|abelgpena|67|Endnotes for The Story of General Grievous, Part 4: Lord of Worlds and War}}</ref> written by [[Daniel Wallace]], which was not published until [[June 27]], 2006.<ref name="Penguin-Paperback">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185065/star-wars-the-new-essential-guide-to-droids-by-daniel-wallace/9780345477590|text=Star Wars: The New Essential Guide to Droids}}</ref>
